_comment: Direct biased-vs-unbiased CKA comparison read from the measured cells. Supersedes the isotropic-Gaussian simulation in script 14 section (e) for the question 'how much does the estimator choice change the reported 1 - CKA'.

files.cka_bias_direct_per_cell.csv: one row per cell: peak layer, ratio at peak, median ratio
files.cka_bias_direct_per_model.csv: one row per model: across-seed mean/std of both ratios
